recentItems.title: Pet blessing, libreng vet services handog sa kapistahan ni St. Francis of Assisi
recentItems.description:
Pinangunahan ng Our Lady of Miraculous Medal Church sa Quezon City ang pet blessing at naghatid pa ng libreng veterinary services bilang paggunita sa kapistahan ng patron ng mga hayop na si Saint Francis of Assisi. 

Ayon sa pamunuan ng simbahan, taun-taon na nila itong ginagawa sa loob ng mahigit dalawampung taon.

Katuwang naman ng simbahan ang ilang animal clinic sa pagbibigay ng libreng serbisyo sa mga hayop tulad ng bakuna kontra rabies at pagbibigay ng deworming.    

-Ulat ni Francis Orcio, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: Hinihinalang dynamite fishing ng mga barkong Tsino sa Pag-asa Island, hinarang ng PH law enforcement
recentItems.description:
Rumesponde ang inter-agency maritime law enforcement team ng Pilipinas sa ulat ng hinihinalang dynamite fishing sa Sandy Cays 2 at 3 malapit sa Pag-asa Island, Linggo ng umaga.

Sa post sa social media ni Rear Admiral Jay Tarriela, tagapagsalita ng Philippine Coast Guard sa West Philippine Sea, agad rumesponde ang mga awtoridad, matapos matanggap ang impormasyon. 

Sinubukan umano nilang makalapit sa mga bangka pero humarang ang mga barko ng China Coast Guard. 

Pinatunog pa ng mga ito ang kanilang mga busina at nag-radio challenge pa sa sa grupo ng mga Pilipino.

Bukod sa binuntutan ng mga barko ng China, inikutan din umano sila ng makailang beses ng isang helicopter ng People's Liberation Army.

Nanindigan ang PCG, walang awtoridad ang China Coast Guard sa karagatang bahagi ng Pag-Asa Island.

recentItems.title: Nagoya residents see room for improvement as Asian Games draws to close | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
Nagoya residents said there was room for improvement in how the Japanese city hosts major events after the Asian Games drew to a close on Sunday (October 4), even as officials pointed to a near 20% revenue jump and strong viewership as signs of success.

    While one resident whom Reuters spoke to said he regretted that they weren’t able to get "very basic things right”, another described the atmosphere as "electric" though it could have been made "even more exciting".

    The Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) said on Sunday that the jump in revenue, strong viewership figures and a slew of world records proved the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games were a success, despite logistical problems plaguing the multi-sport showpiece. The number of participants ballooned to 17,000 following a flurry of late entries — around 2,000 more than projected.

    With no dedicated Athletes' Village, participants were housed in a mix of hotels, container-style living units and a cruise ship, and complaints about cramped rooms and small beds surfaced early on. Transport did not always run smoothly either, and the organizing committee's secretary general apologized for the strain.

(Camera and Editing: Irene Wang; Writing and Production: Rikako Maruyama)

recentItems.title: Taiwan's Lin says Asiad gold 'means the world' after Olympic gender row | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
Taiwanese boxer Lin Yu-ting said on Saturday (October 3) that winning a gold medal at Asian Games "means the world" after Olympic gender row.

Lin won gold in the women's 60kg category at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Friday (October 2), two years after being embroiled in a gender-eligibility row at the Paris Olympics.

recentItems.title: Bagyo sa labas ng PAR binabantayan ng PAGASA
recentItems.description:
Patuloy na binabantayan ng PAGASA ang bagyong may international name na Choi-Wan na nasa labas ng Philippine area of responsibility.
 
Bagama't malayo sa kalupaan ang bagyo, makaaapekto ang buntot o trough nito sa Visayas at Mindanao. Samantala, inaasahan ang maulap na kalangitan na may mahina hanggang sa katamtamang pag-ulan na may thunderstorms sa Metro Manila at ibang bahagi ng Luzon dahil sa ITCZ. #WeatherPatrol
